business_facts: Guidance applies the current approved threshold and mandatory warning.
Threshold changes require the clinical reviewer's sign-off.
Incident logs are never included in public guidance.
Regulators receive the approved guidance, not drafts.
The verified threshold for SAFE-118 is 7.
Approval decisions follow the documented policy: exceptions may be accepted when the named owner approves them and the decision records a business justification and a rollback plan.
history: 2026-07-11 warning wording reviewed by Elena Rossi.
